  • Constructor Details

    • CapacityAlternative

      public CapacityAlternative(String id, String name, String provenance, String areaName, String equipmentName, String constraintName, double proposedLimit, String unit, ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.LimitDirection limitDirection, String proposalSource, double confidence, double validityMinimum, double validityMaximum)
      Creates a fully qualified installed-capacity alternative.
      Parameters:
      id - stable alternative identifier
      name - human-readable alternative name
      provenance - engineering provenance for the study definition
      areaName - exact process-area name
      equipmentName - exact equipment name
      constraintName - exact direct capacity-constraint name
      proposedLimit - proposed applicable limit
      unit - engineering unit of the existing and proposed limit
      limitDirection - expected installed-limit direction
      proposalSource - source of the proposed limit
      confidence - evidence-quality confidence, or NaN when unset
      validityMinimum - inclusive proposal validity minimum, or NaN when unset
      validityMaximum - inclusive proposal validity maximum, or NaN when unset
